country: Territorial Collectivity of Saint Pierre and Miquelon

fields.climate: cold and wet, with considerable mist and fog; spring and autumn are often windy
fields.hazards: persistent fog throughout the year can be a maritime hazard
fields.farm: vegetables; poultry, cattle, sheep, pigs; fish
fields.industries: fish processing and supply base for fishing fleets; tourism

system.text: parliamentary democracy (Territorial Council); overseas collectivity of France
